name: Minimalist Silver Band
shortDescription: A sleek, polished sterling silver band for everyday elegance.
description: Crafted from high-quality sterling silver, this minimalist band features a smooth, polished finish. Its timeless design makes it perfect for stacking or wearing alone as a subtle statement piece.

name: Elegant Gold Link Chain
shortDescription: A delicate 18k gold chain with a classic link design.
description: This elegant chain is crafted from 18k gold, featuring a fine link structure that catches the light beautifully. It's versatile enough to be worn with your favorite pendant or as a minimalist solo piece.

name: Brushed Silver Cuff
shortDescription: A modern silver cuff bracelet with a unique brushed texture.
description: Make a statement with this contemporary silver cuff. The brushed finish gives it a sophisticated, matte look that complements any modern wardrobe. Its open design allows for easy adjustment to fit most wrists.

name: Geometric Ear Cuff
shortDescription: A unique silver ear cuff featuring a geometric cutout design.
description: Add an edgy touch to your look with this geometric ear cuff. No piercing required – simply slide it onto your ear for an instant style upgrade. The intricate cutout pattern adds a modern architectural feel.

name: Classic Pearl Studs
shortDescription: Elegant white pearl studs with a timeless appeal.
description: These elegant pearl studs are a staple for any jewelry collection. Featuring high-lustre white pearls mounted on sterling silver posts, they offer a touch of classic sophistication to any outfit.

name: Brilliant Diamond Pendant
shortDescription: A stunning brilliant-cut diamond pendant on a silver chain.
description: Exude luxury with this brilliant-cut diamond pendant. Suspended from a delicate sterling silver chain, the diamond is set to maximize its fire and brilliance, making it a breathtaking focal point.
